 Rulemaking Information
 Site Navigation
-November 24, 2026 Rulemaking Hearing
-The November 24, 2026 Rulemaking Hearing will held virtually via Teams and begins at 9:30AM.
-If you wish to provide virtual oral testimony in real time during the hearing, please complete and submit the Rulemaking Hearing Testimony Sign-up form below. You may also sign up by submitting your first and last name, email address and which rules/protocols you would like to comment on to pharmacy.rulemaking@bop.oregon.gov no later than 8:30AM on November 24, 2026. You will receive a confirmation email and a calendar invitation to join the virtual hearing.
-Written comments must be received by 4:30PM on November 24, 2026. Submit written comments to pharmacy.rulemaking@bop.oregon.gov.
-If you would like to listen to the hearing, join the virtual
-Teams meeting
-or call: (503) 446-4951 Conference ID: 538650615
 Rulemaking Resources
 Oregon State Pharmacy Statutes & Rules
 Oregon Revised Statutes (ORS)
